import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_71/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_71/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'school_name'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by 'type' from source0 and aggregate average reading_score from source1
result = joined.groupby("type", as_index=False)["reading_score"].mean()

# Ensure the reading_score column is float type (it should be by default)
result["reading_score"] = result["reading_score"].astype(float)

# Sort by 'type' to match target example order (optional but good for consistency)
result = result.sort_values("type").reset_index(drop=True)

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_71/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
